from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNonCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """Non-current assets total reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if provided in the report")
    non_current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Value of total non-current assets (非流动资产合计)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Report period covered, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_non_current_assets_list: list[CompanyNonCurrentAssets]
